name: chromaphore
description: Drive the Chromaphore browser from Claude Code: page listings with ids, human-timed input, page reads through the browser, traffic recordings.

browser_path.title: Browser (optional)
browser_path.description: A chrome.exe of Chromaphore to use instead of the one browser_install downloads. Leave empty to use the installed release.

replay_options.title: Replay options (optional)
replay_options.description: Adds options for replaying input from a pipeline of your own: a start time and a typing seed for input, and a check of a scripted burst against the text it must leave. Most uses do not need them.
